answer_1.quote: In summarization, this "world" is the article, which is taken as ground-truth, and the output summary must be faithful to the article's facts.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate different classes of metrics against the FRANK benchmark. We select four general summarization metrics. ROUGE, BLEU, and Meteor are n-gram based metrics... BERTScore computes BERT contextual embeddings... We select five metrics focused on factuality... OpenIE... FactCC... DAE... FEQA... QAGS...

answer_4.quote: We conduct the annotation task on the Amazon Mechanical Turk (MTurk) platform.
answer_4.guideline: For each sentence in the summary, the annotator first selects whether the sentence is factual, and if marked not factual, identifies the category of each error based on our typology.
